title: Contact lens on a fingertip (captioned Figure 25: Contact Lens)
description: Close-up color photograph of a clear contact lens balanced on a fingertip. Caption: "Figure 25. Contact Lens. Modern contact lenses are made of a mixture of acrylics and silicones that readily pass oxygen to the cornea." The text discusses rigid gas-permeable lenses and introduces 'Drug Delivery Polymers'.
